content: Mʋ́mʋ́ labi mɔmʋ Yudafɔ bʋbʋ dʋn ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ? Ntɛ́ɛ labi mɔmʋ ketétɩ́ɩn bʋ?
Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́á labi ámʋ ɩhɩ́ɛ́ ɩtsɔ! Gyankpapʋ gyí, Bulu lɔ́pʋ mʋ klʋnsʋ asʋ́n wá Yudafɔ ɩbɩtɔ.
Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́ ánɩ́ amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bʋmɔhɔ Bulu asʋ́n ámʋsʋ gyi. Támɛ amʋ́ tsiátɔ́ anfɩ odu ɩbɛ́talɩ́ há Bulu obési tɔ́á ɔlɛhɩɛ ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́bwɛ lóó?
Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Megyí alɩ ígyi! Nɩ́ afunupʋ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ bʋgyi óó á, Bulu mʋ́ á, ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ ogyi. Igyi fɛ́ alɩá Owíe Dawid lɛ́bláa Bulu ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: “Nɩ́ fɔtɔ́ɩ́ á, ahá bʋblɩ́ bɛɛ fʋ́ asʋ́n igyi ɔnɔkwalɩ.
Nɩ́ begyi fʋ́ asʋ́n ɛ́ á, bʋblɩ́ bɛɛ fʋ́ asʋ́n da ɔkpa.”

content: Nɩ́ anɩ tsiátɔ́ laláhɛ lalɛ́ Bulu tsiátɔ́ wankláán súná á, mʋ́mʋ́ nɩ́ ɔdɛ anɩ ɩsʋ bɩtɩ́ anɩ tsiátɔ́ laláhɛ sʋ á, nkálɩ abɛ́blɩ́? Abɛ́blɩ́ anɩaa, Bulu má ɔkpa bɩ́tɩ́ anɩ ɩsʋ? (Nyankpʋsa asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ ndɛblɩ́ á.)
Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Ɩma mʋ́tɔ́ alɩ. Nɩ́ Bulu asʋ́n mɛda ɔkpa á, nkálɩ obégyi ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ asʋ́n?
Ɔkʋ ɔbɛ́fɩtɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, nɩ́ mɩ́ ɔnɔkwalɩmáwá lalɛ́ súná ánɩ́ Bulu bʋ ɔnɔkwalɩ, ɩlatsú mʋ dá fʋ́á á, mʋ́mʋ́ ntɔ sʋ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́trá ha mɩ́ pɔ́n ɔbɛ́ɛ lalahɛ ɔbwɛpʋ́ ngyi?

Nɩ́ igyi alɩ á, mʋ́mʋ́ ntɔ sʋ́ anɩmɛ́ɛblɩ́ anɩaa, “Mlɩha abwɛ lakpan, fówun Bulu tsiátɔ́ wankláán ɩlɩn ɔwan?” Fɛ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ akʋ bʋdɛ mɩ́ ɔnɔ́ tɩn bɛɛ, nna ndɛblɩ́ ámʋ. Bulu ɔbɛ́ha amʋ́ ɩpɔ́n alɩá ɩlɛkanáa.
Ɔhaa Mégyí Yilé Ɔbwɛpʋ́

Nkálɩ mɛɛ abɛ́blɩ́ pʋ́mɔ́ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́? Mʋ́ sʋ anɩ Yudafɔ anɩdʋn ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ ámʋ lóó? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Anɩmɔ́dʋn amʋ́ ɔkpagyíɔkpasʋ. Nablɩ́ bɔtsʋn mbɛ́ɛ, ɩkʋlɛ Yudafɔ pʋ́ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋgyi. Tsúfɛ́ lakpan lagyi amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́.
Bulu asʋ́n lɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: “Ɔhaa asʋ́n mɛda ɔkpa Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́. Ɔbakʋ́lɛ kʋ́ráá mɛ́dalɩ mʋ́tɔ́.
Amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ badámlí ɔma há Bulu,
Yilé ɔbwɛpʋ́ ɔkʋkʋ má ɩnʋ. Ɔbakʋ́lɛ kʋ́ráá mɛ́dalɩ mʋ́tɔ́.”

content: Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ lɛ́trá blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: Amʋ́ ɔnɔ́tɔ́ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ tɔmɔ́ fɛ́ ɩwɔ elín.”

content: Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ lɛ́trá blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
Ɔlɛtrá blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: Ɔtɩ́nɛgyíɔtɩ́nɛ́á bʋna á, bʋdɛ ahá yintá, bʋdɛ ahá ipiantɔ wa.
Bʋmeyín ɔkpa ánɩ́ ɩtɔpʋ́ iwilwii ba.”

content: Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ kʋ ɛ́ lɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
Séi á, anɩyin ánɩ́ asʋ́ngyíasʋ́n ánɩ́ Mose Mbla ámʋ losuná á, ɩda ha Yudafɔ ámʋ́ʋ́ bɔpʋ mbla ámʋ há ámʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔkʋkʋ méenya ɔkpa lɛ́ asʋansʋ ɔnɔ́ brɛ́á Bulu dɛ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ asʋ́n gyí.
Tsúfɛ́ Mose Mbla ámʋsʋ gyí mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ há ɔha ogyi asʋ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́. Há mbla ámʋ ɩtɛhá anɩtɛbɩ́ ánɩ́ lakpan abwɛpʋ́ anɩgyí.
Alɩá Ɔha Tegyi Asʋ Bulu Ansɩ́tɔ́
Séi á, Bulu lasúná ɔkpa ánɩ́ ɔtɔtsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ há ɔha asʋ. Ɩmɛná Mose Mbla ámʋsʋ gyísʋ. Támɛ Mose Mbla ámʋ pʋ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ lɛ́blɩ́ ɔkpa ámʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n yáɩ́.

Ɔkpa ámʋ gyí ɔkpa ánɩ́ Bulu tɔtsʋn há ɔha asʋ mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́ nɩ́. Yesu Kristo hógyisʋ Bulu tɔtsʋn hɔ ɔhagyíɔha. Ma fʋgyi o, ma fʋmegyí o, nkʋ́nʋ fotsú o, nkʋ́nʋ fʋmotsú o, ɔhaa mɔ́tsʋn ɔtsan Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́.
Tsúfɛ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ babwɛ́ lakpan. Mʋ́ sʋ bahʋ́lɩ Bulu numnyam.
Awɩtɔlɛ Bulu lawá há anɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ́ nyankpʋsa obégyi asʋ mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́ nɩ́. Awɩtɔlɛ anfɩ ɩna Kristo Yesusʋ. Mʋlɛ́ka nyankpʋsa nwunsʋ ɩkɔ.

Anyánkpʋ́sa bʋdɛ lakpan bwɛ tsú brɛ́ ɔpá, támɛ Bulu lénya klʋn há amʋ́, ɔmɛbɩtɩ́ amʋ́ ɩsʋ. Séi á, Bulu labɔpʋ Yesu bɔ́ afɔdɩɛ, pʋ́ mʋ obugya lɛ́ anɩ ɩwɩ mbusuo, mɛ́nɩ abɔ́tsʋn mʋ hógyisʋ nyá lakpansikíé. Bulu lɔ́bwɛ mʋ́ alɩ pʋ́súná ánɩ́ mʋ asʋ́n da ɔkpa, mɛ́nɩ ibósuná nkɛ ánfɩtɔ ánɩ́ yilé ɔbwɛpʋ́ ogyi. Ototsú ahá ánɩ́ bɔhɔ Yesu gyi ánɩ́ amʋ́ asʋ́n da ɔkpa mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Séi mɛ́, tɔkʋ bʋ ɩnʋá abótsu ɩwɩ mʋ́sʋ́? Tɔtɔ má ɩnʋ. Ntogyi sʋ́ anɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ tsú ɩwɩ? Mose Mbla ámʋ sʋ lóó? Ó-o! Anɩ hógyi sʋ anɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ tsú ɩwɩ.
Megyí atɔ wankláán ámʋ́ʋ́ Mose Mbla losuná anɩ bwɛ ámʋ sʋ anɩtegyi asʋ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́. Ɩna Kristosʋ hógyisʋ abégyi asʋ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́.
Yudafɔ nkʋlɛ Bulu ógyi? Megyí ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ mʋ́ Bulu ogyi? Ee! Amʋ́ ɛ́ amʋ́ Bulu nɩ́.
Bulu ɔkʋlɛ pɛ́ bʋ ɩnʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɩna hógyisʋ olotsulá ánɩ́ Yudafɔ asʋ́n da ɔkpa. Ɩna hógyi kɛ́nsʋ́ ɔlɔhɔ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ ámʋ ɛ́ ánɩ́ amʋ́ asʋ́n da ɔkpa.
Mʋ́ sʋ ilehián ánɩ́ abɔ́hɔ Yesu gyi, sí Mose Mbla ámʋsʋ hógyi lóó? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Megyí alɩ ígyi. Yesu hógyi tɛ́há anɩtɛkɩ́tá mbla ámʋtɔ kínkíínkín.
